intended_scope: Lattke excitatory-lineage PCW10-20 development donors; actual coverage unverified
format_declared: gzip-compressed R workspace; actual serialized classes unknown

single_next_action_proposal.purpose: Resolve the exact selected href and any published size/checksum declarations, not fetch the object
single_next_action_proposal.controls: Pinned cached Python in an inspected non-root container; absolute deadline; identity HTTP encoding; fail before exceeding body/decode caps; no host-data mounts
single_next_action_proposal.preservation: New output directory only; preserve prior evidence and downloaded R archive; no cache/user-data deletion
single_next_action_proposal.after_success: Review exact source declaration, then separately specify and approve object/class-support inspection limits. Do not GET payload or install Seurat automatically.
single_next_action_proposal.after_failure: Record scoped SOURCE_UNRESOLVED with reason and a response hash when response bytes were received; no retry or source substitution

scientific_acceptance_requirements_uncha: paired raw RNA and measured ATAC counts with exact retained barcode/donor join
genome build, interval coordinates and count units
exact common measured regions; never zero-fill unmatched peaks
separate development, external and cross-cohort decisions
